name: Sol Divided
storyline:
In 2290 humanity has spread across the Solar System, and the four powers that rule it are on the edge of war: the Martian Republic, the Earth Coalition, the Belt colonies and the corporations.

The campaign follows Reyes, a young Martian officer. It begins with an ordinary escort mission: unknown ships attack ice freighters near Phobos, and the wreckage carries military targeting systems. Someone is arming the Belt and pushing the factions towards open war.

The trail leads to the corporations and to a secret project built in the shadows. When Reyes' commander, Mercer, is declared a traitor by the Martian Senate, Reyes has to flee to the Belt and find allies among smugglers, mercenaries, diplomats and former enemies. The story crosses the whole system, from Mercury and Venus to the moons of Jupiter and Saturn and Neptune, across 5 acts and 30 missions.
summary:
Sol Divided is a tactical card game set in the Solar System in the year 2290. Four human factions - Mars, the Earth Coalition, the Belt colonies and the corporations - fight for control of the planets and their orbits. There are no aliens or magic; the setting is focused on people, ships and the reactor cores that power them.

Battles are fought on two lines: ships fight ships and ground units fight ground units, unless a card says otherwise. Each turn the player charges a reactor for more energy, and the side with more ships controls the air and damages the enemy base every turn. A match is won by reducing the enemy base to zero.
